blocks.text: Thank you for getting us set up so quickly. The pricing work for {{fact:f:E-2009-004.client}} is moving on schedule, and I wanted to line up the last of the data we need before we lose any time waiting on it. On our side the streams are all under way: Deborah Gordon has the market and competitor benchmark started, Brenda Rodriguez is into the present-state pricing files, and I am filling in the company and market background.

The gap now is on the pricing detail itself. Three of the schedules we asked for, the ones behind the two largest product lines, have not yet reached us, and Brenda cannot close out the present-state picture without them. If someone on your team can send those over by the middle of next week, we will stay comfortably on track.

I would also like to hold a short working call to walk you through what the benchmark is showing before we go any wider with it. For that call I have you, Barbara Ward, with Mary Parker and Deborah Gordon from our side; Brenda Rodriguez will join if the schedule allows. Could you let me know a half hour that suits you next week, and I will send the three outstanding schedules straight to Deborah the moment they arrive.
